controls.speedHelp: Changes Melo model speaking speed and duration.
controls.sdpRatioHelp: Blends deterministic and stochastic duration prediction. Higher values vary timing more.
controls.acousticNoiseHelp: Controls acoustic sampling variation. Higher values can sound more varied but less stable.
controls.durationNoiseHelp: Controls stochastic variation in phoneme durations.
controls.pitchHelp: Post-processing pitch shift in semitones. Zero skips processing.
controls.tempoHelp: Post-processing tempo multiplier independent of pitch. One skips processing.
controls.volumeHelp: Output volume multiplier. One skips processing. Disabled during normalization.
ssml.title: SSML input
ssml.intro: SSML is used only while the orange SSML mode is active. Plain text remains the default. Melo can switch loaded language models and speakers between dialogue turns.
ssml.voiceHelp: Switch to any speaker currently shown by the Voices endpoint. The speaker selects its native language model unless a language is explicitly nested.
ssml.languageHelp: Switch language models while retaining the current speaker. The speaker must exist in that model; use voice for reliable multilingual dialogue.
ssml.prosodyHelp: Style one segment. Omitted or blank values inherit unchanged.
ssml.breakHelp: Set the complete pause at this boundary, up to 10 seconds. Use 0ms for no gap; adjacent turns use 100ms.
ssml.subHelp: Speak the alias instead of the visible label.
ssml.ordinalHelp: Read an English ordinal. This is limited to English models.
ssml.limits: Prosody ranges are speed and tempo 0.5-2, pitch -12st to +12st, and volume 0-2. Nested values compose with request controls and must remain in range. Complete-file normalization remains request-wide. One speak root is required. Documents are limited to 50,000 characters, 256 elements, and eight nesting levels. Breaks are limited to 10 seconds each and 30 seconds total. Unsupported markup, unsafe XML, and direct phoneme input are rejected.
